<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Celestial Dragons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212539441975296.png?v=1" alt="celestialdragon" title="celestialdragon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are generally only killed for the Ultimate Slayer title. Otherwise, the XP and GP/hr are mediocre at best.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 1</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 976.6</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~650 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212539441975296.png?v=1" alt="celestialdragon" title="celestialdragon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be found in the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragontooth_Island_resource_dungeon <nowiki>Dragontooth Island resource dungeon</nowiki>]<nowiki> after the question </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/One_of_a_Kind <nowiki>One of a Kind</nowiki>]<nowiki> is complete.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>You can get there by:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Option 0 → 3 on the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dungeoneering_cape <nowiki>Dungeoneering cape</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/976732922545586246.png?v=1" alt="dgcape" title="dgcape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (option 0 → 3).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Max_guild_portal <nowiki>Max guild portal</nowiki>]<nowiki> tuned to the Radiant Wisp colony.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Teleport to Dragontooth Island using the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Big_Book_o%27_Piracy <nowiki>Big Book o' Piracy</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can also go to Port Phasmatys (Ectophial teleport or charter a boat) and speak with the Ghost captain while wearing a ghostspeak amulet.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-ranged"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK Ranged</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Place your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the middle of the room and ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1" alt="autoretaliate" title="autoretaliate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>With this </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> method trips are only limited by your supplies (e.g. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and cannonballs).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1" alt="anguish" title="anguish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1" alt="desolation" title="desolation" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1" alt="bonecrusher" title="bonecrusher" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492695997513748.png?v=1" alt="superantifire" title="superantifire" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/YSnu4Zec7z.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
